newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle top at $120/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle top at $120/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were near steady on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs mostly 119.00; some mainly Select to 118.00; some mostly Choice to 120.00. ( weighted average 118.90 )
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 118.50- 119.00; some mainly Select 118.00; some mostly Choice 120.00. ( weighted average 118.89).

Slaughter steers and heifers were near steady. Buyer inquiry fair. Seller interest light as most showlists already traded. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 73.50- 74.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1225 lbs 73.50-74.00.
For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis mostly $1.00 higher; dressed basis mostly $2.00 higher.
Weekly total includes 7,600 formulated and previously contracted cattle.
Wk To Date- 80,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 68,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 80,000
